title: Fravor and Dietrich disagree on how long the encounter lasted
summary: Mick West tells of Fravor and Dietrich disagree on how long the encounter lasted, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Dietri says her experience only lasted five, sorry, 8 to 10 seconds. the entire thing from merge plot to the thing flying away,

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, two Navy fighter pilots, David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, say they saw a white oval object, shaped like a Tic Tac mint, over the Pacific. Mick West, a researcher known for skeptical analysis of UFO cases, points out on Jesse Michels's podcast that Dietrich says her whole experience, from first meeting the object to it flying away, lasted only 8 to 10 seconds. He raises this because it differs from Fravor's account, and the gap matters for how much the pilots could really have seen.
